# buracle command reference

One section per command: what it is for and how it is called. `buracle <command> --help` prints the rest (subcommands, flags, effects, exit codes); read it before the first use of a command in a session. Every command takes `--json`. Exit codes: 0 success · 1 error · 2 partial success, or the user needs to act.

## build

Generate harness/* from canonical/ and src/core (--check: determinism and drift, writes nothing)

```text
buracle build [--check] [--harness <h>[,<h>…]] [--json]
```

## install

Set up or repair Buracle Stack in every detected harness (first setup included)

```text
buracle install [<harness>…] [--dry-run] [--yes] [--json]
buracle install --script --log <file> [--started <epoch ms>] [--yes]
```

## uninstall

Remove everything Buracle Stack installed (ledger-proven), undo its commands; never touches the memory

```text
buracle uninstall [--purge-state] [--dry-run] [--yes] [--json]
```

## doctor

Health checks: config, tools, harness adapters and their hooks, MCP and LSP handshakes, memory, code indexes and the update cache

```text
buracle doctor [<harness>|runtime|mcp|lsp|tools|memory|index|config] [--all] [--json]
```

## index

Build, refresh or show the codegraph and semble indexes of a project

```text
buracle index [status] [--cwd <dir>] [--json]
buracle index ensure [--cwd <dir>] [--if-due] [--quiet] [--json]
buracle index rebuild [--cwd <dir>] [--force] [--json]
```

## update

Update everything Buracle Stack connects, each part from its own source

```text
buracle update [<kind>|<name>…] [--check] [--yes] [--json]
```

## config

Read or change the live configuration: get <key>, set <key> <value>, unset <key>, path

```text
buracle config get [<dotted.key>] [--json]
buracle config set <dotted.key> <value> [--string]
buracle config unset <dotted.key>
buracle config path [--json]
```

## hook

Command-hook entry point for harnesses: payload on stdin, response on stdout

```text
buracle hook <harness> <event>
```

## statusline

Render the status line for a harness (it reads the host's session JSON on stdin)

```text
buracle statusline <claude|qwen|agy> [--width N] [--format ansi|plain] [--style buracle|full|compact] [--json]
buracle statusline claude --subagent
```

## usage

Collect usage per harness and refresh the usage cache

```text
buracle usage [refresh] [--harness <h>] [--offline] [--json]
```

## mem

Memory (one CortexDB brain: a bucket per project and one for the person): search, get, write, update, status, capture, backup, web UI

```text
buracle mem <subcommand> [args…] [--json]
```

## mcp

Run, share, turn off and inspect Buracle Stack's MCP servers and set their API keys (buracle mcp run <id>, disable, status, key)

```text
buracle mcp memory
buracle mcp run <id>
buracle mcp disable <id> [--harness <h>]
buracle mcp enable <id> [--harness <h>]
buracle mcp list [--json]
buracle mcp status [--json]
buracle mcp stop [<id>]
buracle mcp key [<id> [<key>]] [--clear] [--json]
buracle mcp install <id>
buracle mcp backend <id> [--package-version=<v>] [--api-key-env=<name>]
```

## lsp

Run, bridge or check Buracle Stack's language servers (buracle lsp run <id>, buracle lsp mcp)

```text
buracle lsp run <id>
buracle lsp mcp
buracle lsp list [--json]
buracle lsp check [<id>…] [--json]
```

## plan

Plan contract and state machine (init, capture, validate, register, prepare-native, status, set, pause, resume, complete, approve-result, verify, review, audit, notes)

```text
buracle plan <subcommand> [args…] [--json]
```

## flow

Record the progress of a running workflow (start, phase, step, end)

```text
buracle flow start <workflow> [--title "<t>"] [--json]
buracle flow phase <phase> [--note "<text>"] [--json]
buracle flow step "<text>" [--done <n>] [--total <m>] [--json]
buracle flow end [--outcome done|failed|cancelled] [--json]
```

## worktree

Isolated worktrees and branches for plans (create, branch, detect, diff, cleanup, status)

```text
buracle worktree <subcommand> [args…] [--json]
```

## review-scope

Print the diff range a review should read (base...HEAD)

```text
buracle review-scope [--slug <slug>] [--base <ref>] [--json]
```

## consent

Run a command the user approved in the harness's own consent prompt (Codex, H20)

```text
buracle consent run <id> <command>
```

## project

Per-project agent files: AGENTS.md, skill links, the path-rule index, the project brain, .git/info/exclude

```text
buracle project sync [--adopt [--move] [--dry-run]] [--auto] [--quiet] [--json]
buracle project check [--json]
```

## skills

Lint, list, scaffold, find, install or update skills

```text
buracle skills <subcommand> [--json]
```

## rules

Lint rules (size budget, references, routing list)

```text
buracle rules lint [<rules-dir>] [--strict] [--json]
```
